summary: ENERGI CONTROL AS (org. no. 988 970 492) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-12-17. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 81.100 (Kombinerte tjenester tilknyttet eiendomsdrift); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 0 and net income was NOK 5.6 m. CEO: Arild Brede Magnussen; board chair: Arild Brede Magnussen; auditor: VELLE REVISJON AS.
